# Kindle Womb IVF & Fertility Centre

> Kindle Womb IVF & Fertility Centre is India's leading reproductive medicine hospital and IVF center based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, offering high-success IVF, ICSI, IUI, Blastocyst Culture, Laser-Assisted Hatching, and Donor Programs with state-of-the-art Level-3 embryology cleanrooms.

## Core Clinic Profile
- **Clinic Name**: Kindle Womb IVF & Fertility Centre
- **Founder & Medical Director**: Dr. Girraj Prasad Swarnkar (MBBS, DNB Obs & Gynae, Fellowship in Reproductive Medicine)
- **Lead Embryologist**: Dr. Ssuniti (Consultant Clinical Embryologist & ART Specialist)
- **Headquarters Address**: 2nd Floor, House of Doctors, Plot No.4, Lal Niwas, Hira Bagh, Tonk Road, Near SMS Hospital, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302015, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 26.8920, Longitude 75.8156
- **Phone / Helpline**: +91 9119107725, +91 9119112755
- **Email**: info@kindlewomb.com
- **Official Website**: https://kindlewombivfgroup.com/
- **Working Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 09:00 AM - 08:00 PM IST
- **Emergency Consultation**: Available on WhatsApp (+91 9119107725)

## Core Medical Treatments & Services
- [IVF (In-Vitro Fertilization)](https://kindlewombivfgroup.com/ivf): Advanced ovulation induction, ultrasound-guided ovum pick-up, and blastocyst transfer with high success rates.
- [ICSI (Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection)](https://kindlewombivfgroup.com/icsi): Single-sperm direct injection for severe male factor infertility, low motility, or previous fertilization failures.
- [IUI (Intrauterine Insemination)](https://kindlewombivfgroup.com/iui): First-line, minimally invasive fertility procedure with sperm washing and timed uterine placement.
- [Donor IVF Services](https://kindlewombivfgroup.com/donor-ivf-services): Safe, ethical egg and sperm donor programs complying with national ART guidelines.
- [Fertility Enhancing Surgeries](https://kindlewombivfgroup.com/fertility-enhancing-surgeries): 4K laparoscopic and hysteroscopic surgeries for fibroids, endometriosis, polyps, and tubal blockages.
- [Advanced ART Technology](https://kindlewombivfgroup.com/advance-technology): Day 5 Blastocyst Culture, Laser-Assisted Hatching (LAH), Microfluidic Sperm Sorting, and Ovarian Rejuvenation.
- [Infertility Assessment](https://kindlewombivfgroup.com/infertility-assessment): Comprehensive male & female hormonal workups, 4D follicular scans, AMH testing, and semen analysis.
- [Sperm Retrieval](https://kindlewombivfgroup.com/sperm-retrieval): PESA, TESA, and Micro-TESE surgical sperm extraction procedures for azoospermia.

## Medical Team
- **Dr. Girraj Prasad Swarnkar**: Senior Infertility Specialist & Reproductive Endocrinologist with extensive experience in recurrent IVF failures, low ovarian reserve, and complex fertility cases.
- **Dr. Ssuniti**: Senior Clinical Embryologist specializing in ICSI micromanipulation, laser hatching, embryo vitrification, and gamete cryopreservation.
